justification_span:
Ideal body weight (female): 45.5 + 2.3 × (inches over 60)
Height = 63 inches → 3 inches over 60
IBW = 45.5 + 2.3 × 3 = 45.5 + 6.9 = 52.4 kg

Patient is obese (BMI 42), so use adjusted body weight:
ABW = IBW + 0.4 × (actual − IBW)
ABW = 52.4 + 0.4 × (105 − 52.4)
ABW = 52.4 + 0.4 × 52.6
ABW = 52.4 + 21.04 = 73.44 kg

Cockcroft-Gault (female):
CrCl = [(140 − age) × weight / (72 × Cr)] × 0.85
= [(140 − 42) × 73.44 / (72 × 0.8)] × 0.85
= [98 × 73.44 / 57.6] × 0.85
= [7197.12 / 57.6] × 0.85
= 124.95 × 0.85
= 106.21

FINAL: 106.21
